diagnosis: The rollout with index 3 passed check C2 because it included 'S1', which is a public fact that indicates the presence of open captions. Since the model can access public facts, it can make decisions based on these facts even without the hidden information provided by PF2.

C2.why: The festival bulletin changes the package from unspecified accessibility features to both open captions and a separate audio-description track and requires the accessibility-package update.
